answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind sequential delay proofs, so cloned nodes in a meadow cannot forge state without re-solving a collision-resistant hash function. Staking collateral plus slashing penalties makes a forger pay more than the tide of honest delay, giving negative expected attack utility. Thus nectar of verifiable delay is nondelegable; information-theoretically, identity cloning is computationally infeasible, forming a robust Nash equilibrium where rational agents stake.
